rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday adverb for a moderate degree, as in “quite wet.”
Use this when “quite” means completely or in full, especially before verbs such as 同意.

example.english: I quite agree with what you're saying.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 tung4 ji3 nei5 ge3 gong2 faat3
